title: Spotlight on Moreno Valley Business - Momma Mondragon's Macarons
excerpt: Indulge in the irresistible world of exquisite flavors at Momma Mondragon's Macarons, your go-to destination for delectable macarons in Moreno Valley, California. Our artisanal macarons are meticulously crafted with love and precision, c...
description:
Indulge in the irresistible world of exquisite flavors at Momma Mondragon's Macarons, your go-to destination for delectable macarons in Moreno Valley, California. Our artisanal macarons are meticulously crafted with love and precision, creating a symphony of taste and texture in every bite.
Elevate your morning routine with our freshly brewed coffee, expertly prepared to kickstart your day. Pair it with our flaky and buttery croissants, a heavenly combination that sets the tone for a delightful experience.
Explore beyond macarons and croissants - our array of pastries showcases the finest in French-inspired baking. From light and airy to rich and decadent, each pastry is a testament to our commitment to quality.
Quench your thirst with our refreshing hand crafted Italian sodas and zesty fresh squeezed lemonades, perfect companions to the Southern California sun. Momma Mondragon's invites you to relax and unwind in our charming locale, where every sip is a celebration.
As Moreno Valley's go-to destination for sweet indulgence, Momma Mondragon's Macarons promises an unparalleled culinary experience. Join us and discover the perfect harmony of flavors, passion, and artisanal craftsmanship. Your journey to sensory delight begins here.

title: Spotlight on Moreno Valley Business - Rising Stars Business Academy
excerpt:
Since opening in 2010, the Rising Stars Business Academy (RSBA) has served nearly 1,000 youth, and graduated over 600 members with their WASC Accredited High School Diplomas.

RSBA serves youth who have been or are still socially underse...
description:
Since opening in 2010, the Rising Stars Business Academy (RSBA) has served nearly 1,000 youth, and graduated over 600 members with their WASC Accredited High School Diplomas.

RSBA serves youth who have been or are still socially underserved, dropped out, aged out, pushed out, wards of the state/court, probation youth, credit deficient, previously incarcerated, gang affiliated, homeless, and the like. RSBA’s services have included mentoring, gang prevention/intervention, anger management, alcohol/substance abuse classes, life skills, leadership development, occupational/vocational training, college readiness, counseling, high school diploma, community service opportunities and job placement. RSBA graduates have gone onto college, military, the work force and even started their own businesses, providing services to the community in which they live.
